plan.notes: Source: UAFS 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog program page (poid=1255). CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the catalog footer states 120 total hours but the semester listing sums to 121: Semester 2 prints 15 but courses total 17 (1+3+3+3+4+3), Semester 3 prints 16 but courses total 15; per collection rule total_credits = sequenced sum = 121. Concentrations: Literary and Cultural Studies, Creative Writing, Professional Writing. Additional degree requirement 40 hrs (minor required). World language 8 hrs through Beginning II. Transcribed 2026-10-01 from a live-browser harvest of the official catalog.
